failure.stage: final artifact writer after all 36 checkpoints and checkpoint manifest
failure.exception: UndefVarError: checkpoint_manifest_sha256 not defined in Main.ExperimentSingular001
failure.cause: The frozen writer referenced checkpoint_manifest_sha256, run_identity_sha256 and warmup_sha256 as module globals but its keyword signature and frozen runner call did not supply them.
failure.numerical_or_gate_effect: none; the failure occurred after checkpointed numerical rows and the in-memory summary were complete, before raw.json, summary.json, environment.json, report.md or result-bindings.json was written

repair_boundary.allowed: checkpoint-only read/verify/replay, recomputation of the already-frozen summary, installation of the three bound hashes as const String globals required by the frozen writer, staged artifact generation and terminal-marker publication
repair_boundary.forbidden: executing any baseline/candidate/control mechanism, changing a checkpoint, changing any implementation-freeze source, changing a predicate/threshold/order/assessment, retuning the candidate, materializing locked inputs or connecting product code
repair_boundary.checkpoint_read_rule: read each checkpoint payload once, verify SHA-256 on those bytes, then parse the same bytes
repair_boundary.provenance_read_rule: hash and parse A7, run identity and checkpoint manifest from their approved byte snapshots; carry approved hashes and reverify the full implementation freeze, Gold/base artifacts and checkpoint collection immediately before terminal publication

finalization_publication.staging: generate raw, summary, environment, report and result bindings in a same-filesystem sibling temporary directory
finalization_publication.verification: verify all writer-returned hashes before publication
finalization_publication.nonterminal_phase: publish raw, summary, environment and report idempotently; existing equal hashes pass and any difference fails closed
finalization_publication.preterminal_recheck: require the exact top-level archive set, all 37 implementation-freeze sources, Gold/input/runtime artifacts, checkpoint manifest and all 36 checkpoint hashes to remain unchanged
finalization_publication.partial_retry: a missing terminal marker permits regeneration; already-published nonterminal files must exactly match regenerated hashes
